title: Experimental library header <experimental/ranges/algorithm>
summary: This header is part of the ranges library.
html:
This header is part of the ranges library.

Tag specifiers

Defined in namespace std::experimental::ranges::tag
inin1in2outout1out2funminmaxbeginend
 tag specifiers for use with ranges::tagged
(class)

Non-modifying sequence operations

Defined in namespace std::experimental::ranges
all_ofany_ofnone_of

(function template)
for_each

(function template)

(function template)

(function template)

(function template)

#include <initializer_list>
 
namespace std { namespace experimental { namespace ranges { inline namespace v1 {
 
namespace tag {

}
 
template <InputIterator I, Sentinel<I> S, class Proj = identity,
